job.job_description:
Technical Skills (Must Have) IBM watsonx Orchestrate

2+ years hands-on experience with IBM watsonx Orchestrate
Expert knowledge of Agent builder and tools implementation.
Experience with implementing the RAG usecases
Proficiency in watsonx.ai model integration
Understanding of watsonx.data for data management
Understanding of IBM Docling



Integration Technologies


Strong experience with REST API development and consumption
Proficiency in OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT authentication
Experience with Microsoft Graph API and SharePoint REST API
Familiarity with webhook and event-driven architectures



Programming & Scripting


6-8 Years of Experience with Python (required)
Proficient in JavaScript/Node.js (preferred)
Knowledge of JSON, XML data formats
Understanding of API design patterns (REST, GraphQL)
Experience with Git version control
